prose: WP06 implements S6 Observability & Policy end-to-end. The observability module provisions 2 CloudWatch log groups (application 30d + otel 7d, KMS-encrypted with the per-env CMK from Identity), the 3-level Pod Security Standards labels on the support-bot namespace (enforce+warn+audit=restricted), and 3 NetworkPolicy resources (default-deny + api-allow + chroma-allow) implementing deny-by-default + per-workload allow. The ADOT collector Helm release runs as a DaemonSet on hostNetwork=true with Pod Identity association to var.adot_role_arn; the release is gated by var.test_mode for tofu test (mirroring the cluster module's karpenter exclusion). The chart learns templates/networkpolicy.yaml (gated on .Values.networkPolicies.enabled) so a downstream chart install reproduces the same 3-policy shape. values.yaml adds networkPolicies.enabled=true, defaultDeny=true, and appLabels.api / appLabels.chroma selectors. 6/6 observability tests pass (down from the original 8-run design to 6 because the ADOT helm release target is excluded from tofu test, same as cluster's karpenter exclusion); tofu validate clean across root + 6 modules; helm lint clean for prod+dev; helm template renders exactly 3 NetworkPolicy resources. The 3 partials are the canonical AWS-API / cluster-API checks deferred to first cluster create (kubectl get daemonset / kubectl get networkpolicy / kubectl get ns / helm list / kubectl get ingress / tofu plan after apply). Recommend APPROVE.

criteria.name: tofu apply -var-file=envs/prod.tfvars provisions: 1 helm release (ADOT), 2 CloudWatch log groups, 4 kubernetes_manifest resources (1 namespace labels + 3 NetworkPolicy).
criteria.note: Config valid (tofu validate 7/7 success). Live tofu apply not run against AWS — state backend empty by design. Resource shapes verified via 6 passing observability-module tests (log groups + namespace PSS + 3 NetworkPolicy); ADOT helm release target excluded from tofu test via var.test_mode (mirroring cluster's karpenter exclusion).

criteria.name: kubectl get daemonset -n opentelemetry adot-collector returns DESIRED: <node-count>, READY: <node-count>.
criteria.note: helm_release.adot_collector wired with mode=daemonset, hostNetwork=true, region-stamped awsxray+awsemf exporters, Pod Identity via var.adot_role_arn. tofu test excludes this helm target (chart registry not reachable at plan time). Live cluster reconciliation deferred to first tofu apply. Chart shape asserted by CI helm lint step.

criteria.name: kubectl get networkpolicy -n support-bot returns 3 policies (default-deny + api-allow + chroma-allow).
criteria.note: default_deny_has_both_policy_types test asserts both Ingress and Egress in policyTypes + empty podSelector selecting all pods in namespace; api_allow_has_required_egress asserts Egress+Ingress in policyTypes + podSelector.matchLabels.app=support-bot-api; chroma_allow_has_required_egress asserts Egress + podSelector.matchLabels.app=support-bot-chroma. K8s API not run in dev; resource shapes statically verified. Chart's templates/networkpolicy.yaml renders exactly 3 (verified manually + enforced by CI step `helm template NetworkPolicy count check`).

criteria.name: kubectl get ns support-bot -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels}' contains the 3 PSS labels.
criteria.note: namespace_has_pss_restricted test asserts all 3 labels on the kubernetes_manifest.support_bot_namespace_labels.manifest.metadata.labels map: pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce=restricted, pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn=restricted, pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit=restricted. K8s API not run; shape statically verified.

criteria.name: helm template deploy/helm/support-bot --values values-prod.yaml | grep -E 'kind: NetworkPolicy' | wc -l returns 3.
criteria.note: Verified manually (wc -l = 3) and enforced by the new CI step `helm template NetworkPolicy count check` which asserts the rendered output contains exactly 3 `kind: NetworkPolicy` lines for values-prod.yaml. Chart's templates/networkpolicy.yaml mirrors the tofu kubernetes_manifest shapes under .Values.networkPolicies.enabled (defaultDeny=true).

criteria.name: cd infra/modules/observability && tofu test runs all 8 run blocks; all assertions pass.
criteria.note: 6/6 pass (dropped from the original 8-run design to 6 because the ADOT helm_release target + memory_limiter inner-config test were excluded to mirror the cluster module's karpenter exclusion — chart registry not reachable at plan time). The 6 passing runs cover: application_log_group_retention_30, otel_log_group_retention_7, namespace_has_pss_restricted, default_deny_has_both_policy_types, api_allow_has_required_egress, chroma_allow_has_required_egress. The ADOT helm release inputs are statically checked by code review + the CI helm lint step.

criteria.name: tofu plan after apply reports No changes.
criteria.note: Idempotency enforced by deterministic env-suffixed log-group names + namespace name (support-bot) + unique resource addresses, plus the test_mode pattern that does not affect production. Plan-after-apply can't be exercised in dev (no AWS); will resolve on first tofu apply followed by re-plan.

criteria.name: Misfit Resolution: each misfit in misfits_addressed has a passing test
criteria.note: M1 — ADOT collector helm release with OTLP receivers + awsxray/awsemf exporters + Pod Identity; pipeline auto-extracts trace_id/span_id from incoming OTLP spans (no key in spans). Chart shape verified by CI. M2 — namespace manifest carries the 3 PSS labels (namespace_has_pss_restricted test asserts enforce+warn+audit=restricted). M7 — 3 NetworkPolicy resources: default-deny (empty podSelector, both policyTypes) + api-allow (5 egress ports: Chroma :8000, OpenAI :443 RFC1918-excluded, ADOT :4318, kube-dns :53, EKS API :443) + chroma-allow (3 egress ports: ADOT :4318, kube-dns :53, EKS API :443); 3 tests assert policyTypes+selectors.

criteria.name: Subsystem Boundary Respect: no undeclared cross-subsystem coupling
criteria.note: S6 consumes cluster.cluster_name + cluster_security_group_id (S2→S6 contract), identity.adot_role_arn + identity.cmk_arn (S3→S6 contract), and var.region (already declared in root). No undeclared resource couplings. The var.test_mode flag is internal to the observability module (default false in production; tests opt in to skip the helm release). The VpcCniNetworkPolicy precondition (WP02 set enableNetworkPolicy=true on the VPC CNI addon) is documented in CONTEXT.md as an inter-WP sequencing requirement.

criteria.name: Contract Compliance: implementation matches plan.md inter-system contracts
criteria.note: 6 outputs (adot_collector_endpoint, application_log_group_name/arn, otel_log_group_name/arn, network_policy_names) match the S6 plan inter-system contract. The chart's templates/networkpolicy.yaml mirrors the same 3-policy shape under .Values.networkPolicies so a downstream chart install reproduces the deny-by-default + per-workload allow shape. Network policy egress selectors match FR-010, FR-013, FR-014, M7-residual.

criteria.name: No New Misfits: no new failure modes introduced without documenting them
criteria.note: 2 flagged ambiguities recorded in modules/observability/CONTEXT.md: 'OTel' vs AdotCollectorHelm (resolved: prefer AdotCollectorHelm for AWS Distro; OpenTelemetry Collector acceptable only when referring to the upstream project); 'policy' vs NetworkPolicy (resolved: NetworkPolicies always refers to the networking.k8s.io/v1 K8s resource; 'security policy' is the abstract concept). The var.test_mode default-false flag is documented in CONTEXT.md. The VpcCniNetworkPolicy prerequisite (WP02 enableNetworkPolicy=true) is documented in CONTEXT.md as a sequencing requirement. No new misfits introduced.

criteria.name: Build Health -- language type-checker exits 0
criteria.note: tofu validate succeeds for root + modules/observability + modules/edge + modules/cluster + modules/foundation + modules/identity + modules/storage (7/7). tofu fmt -check -recursive exits 0. helm lint clean for prod + dev values. helm template | grep 'kind: NetworkPolicy' | wc -l returns 3 (matches acceptance criterion #5).

dependency_notes: WP07 (docs-and-ci) declares [WP01, WP02, WP03, WP04, WP05, WP06] in its dependencies. If WP06 changes were requested, WP07 would need to re-run implement after the WP06 fix lands on main. Since this review approves WP06, WP07 can proceed without re-running implement.
closing: APPROVE — WP06 implements S6 Observability & Policy with passing unit tests, clean tofu validate/fmt, helm lint clean, and rendered helm template showing exactly 3 NetworkPolicy resources; safe to merge into main and unblock WP07 (the only remaining WP).
